content: H5N1 Technical Report May 31, 2024 What to know These technical reports are intended for scientific audiences. Additional information for scientific audiences and the general public is available on CDC’s Information on Bird Flu webpage. Technical Report: June 2024 Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1) Viruses Read the latest H5N1 technical report for information on H5N1 outbreaks globally. June 5, 2024 Technical Report: April 2024 Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1) Viruses Report reviews outbreaks of influenza A(H5N1) viruses in animals and risk for public health.
